In every file the new line goes right before `import re`, after the TODO comment and the docstring. A `__future__` import has to come after the module docstring, and putting it there means the docstring is still recognised as the module's docstring.

**Tests:** pytest isn't installed, so I ran them with `python3 -m unittest discover`, and all 6 passed. None of them touch `shop/carriers`, though. To check the edited files directly, I imported each of the 20 modules, and all imported without errors.

Nothing is committed.
